mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_plan (tenant_id, plan_id, plan_version, member_quota, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{planId}, #{version}, #{memberQuota}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET plan_id = EXCLUDED.plan_id, plan_version = EXCLUDED.plan_version, member_quota = EXCLUDED.member_quota, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE tenant_plan.plan_version < EXCLUDED.plan_version AND NOT tenant_plan.deleted
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM tenant_plan_sub_app WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY code
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted)
SELECT code FROM tenant_plan_permission WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY code
SELECT member_quota FROM tenant_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
